# Hi, I'm Tori. I turn [race data]{.accent} into answers.

I'm finishing an M.S. in Data Analytics (Sport Performance & Sport Business) at the University of Mississippi, with a B.S. in Kinesiology from Oregon State. I build models in R and SQL around the sports I watch and race: Formula 1, marathons and Ironman 70.3.
:::

### [My 70.3 run pace](projects/ironman-pace/index.qmd)
A regression model trained on 179 of my own runs, then tested on 12 runs it never saw.
:::

### [Does pole actually win?](projects/f1-sql/index.qmd)
A MySQL database of 75 years of F1 results, queried to measure how starting position drives outcomes.
